result.question: Quais são os 5 municípios com maior percentual de internações em UTI (com mais de 5000 internações)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT mu.nome AS municipio, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_uti FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ORDER BY pct_uti DESC LIMIT 5;
result.generated_sql: WITH internacoes_uti AS ( SELECT "MUNIC_RES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes_uti FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_UTI" > 0 GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES" ), total_internacoes AS ( SELECT "MUNIC_RES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ) SELECT mu."nome" AS municipio, ROUND(COALESCE(i.total_internacoes_uti, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_internacoes, 0), 2) AS proporcao, t.total_internacoes FROM total_internacoes t JOIN internacoes_uti i ON t."MUNIC_RES" = i."MUNIC_RES" JOIN municipios mu ON t."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" GROUP BY mu."nome", t.total_internacoes, i.total_internacoes_uti ORDER BY proporcao DESC LIMIT 5;
